r15-protect-switch.title: A switch to turn off copy blocking
body: Today Shiftbook blocks copying text out of the app, and the **Protected** button in the top bar lets copying through for 10 minutes before the timer turns it back on. That button also hides the window from screenshots.

You asked for a way to turn this off for people who don't want it. Here is a new switch in **Settings → Security**. Both stay on by default for new installs, so nothing changes unless someone turns it off.
The recovery key's own Copy button still empties the clipboard after 60 seconds either way, since that key unlocks everything.

figures.caption: **Settings → Security** with the two switches (dashed), and what the top-bar button does in each case.

options.value: Two switches: copying and screenshots separately
options.why: Someone who wants to copy freely can still keep their screen hidden in screen shares.

options.value: One switch that turns both off

questions.legend: Ask "are you sure?" when turning one off?

options.value: Yes, ask once with a short warning

r15-protect-switch.pick: Two separate switches, both on by default, with a one-time warning when turning one off.
